hooks.name: Session Wrapup
hooks.description: Single consolidated agentStop hook: beads sync, tenet audit, QA triage, docs check, UX review.

action.prompt:
SESSION WRAPUP — max 5 bullets, skip anything that doesn't apply, no prose.

No files changed → skip silently.

Otherwise only flag what needs action:
• BEADS — unclosed claimed tasks? close or leave in_progress
• TENETS — violations found? fix + foreman_guardian_check
• QA — property test gaps? delegate to qa-tester (one line)
• DOCS — MCP/interface changes? delegate to doc-writer (one line)
• UX — views.py changed? Playwright screenshot + list suggestions

Omit passing items entirely.
